title: ORION: Ordinary Repository for Input-Output Necessities
description:
ORION is a modular I/O toolkit for reading and writing structured, multi-block scientific data across multiple file formats. It provides both Fortran and Python interfaces, plus a standalone command-line converter, designed for integration into high-performance and scientific computing workflows.

Supported formats: Tecplot (ASCII, and binary via TecIO), VTK and PLOT3D.

Documentation: MarcoGrossi92.github.io/ORION

ORION builds upon Lib_VTK_IO (BSD-3-Clause) and OFF (GPL-3.0).
